comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, wages-and-child-single-cdcc whose filer paid 1,000 of 2024 care expenses in 2025 and claimed the 2024 credit on less than the maximum — Form 2441's Worksheet A gives a second credit of 220.00 on top of the current-year 600.00; line 24 = 645.00 (865.00 before the worksheet was asked).
